# API conventions

## Errors
Every endpoint returns a single error envelope:

    {"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "context": {}, "request_id": "..."}}

Status codes: 400 validation_error, 401 unauthorized, 404 not_found, 409 conflict.

## Style
Light first. One accent colour. No decorative gradients. Numbers use tabular figures.
